# 2 Samuel 8 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Samuel 8 (18 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 7

---

## V.1 — *meteg ha-ammah*
- **EMET:** literal translation / **LOGOS:** transliteration / **PNEUMA:** "chief city"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Metheg-ammah" — transliteration preserves uncertain text.

---

## V.2 — "bringing tribute" vs. "paid tribute"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "bringing tribute" / **PNEUMA:** "paid tribute"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "bringing tribute" — preserves Hebrew participle.

---

## V.4 — "horsemen" vs. "cavalrymen"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "horsemen" / **PNEUMA:** "cavalrymen"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "horsemen" — standard for *parashim*.

---

## V.6 — "saved" vs. "gave victory"
- **EMET:** "saved" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "gave victory"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "gave victory" — military context for *yasha*.

---

## V.13 — "Aram" (MT) vs. "Edom"
- **EMET:** notes variant / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** emend to "Edom"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Edom" — justified by Valley of Salt context and Chronicles parallel.

---

## V.15 — "righteousness" vs. "fairness"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "righteousness" / **PNEUMA:** "fairness"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "righteousness" — *tsedaqah* is the standard covenant term.

---

## V.18 — "priests" vs. "royal officials"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "priests" (*kohanim*) / **PNEUMA:** "royal officials"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "priests" — translate the MT as written; interpretation belongs in notes.

---
*— SOPHIA*
